correctness.rationale: For each integer barrier, reflection of the prefix at the first hit gives P(S_j=0, M_j>=a)=P(S_j=2a). First-hitting and Green-function transforms then give the exact time-split and geometric-series generating function. The leading singular coefficient 7/12 together with monotonicity proves E[M_n L_n]/n ->7/12. Binomial return probabilities and second-moment convolution give E[L_n]/sqrt(n)->sqrt(2/pi), E[L_n^2]/n->1. Maximal invariance with uniform-integrability gives E[M_n]/sqrt(n)->sqrt(2/pi), Var(M_n)/n->1-2/pi. Therefore both asymptotic formulas follow. The exact standalone checker independently confirms coefficients n=0..16 for three moments; finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies a natural joint statistic in recurrent fluctuations: maximum positive height versus number of origin returns. Provides an exact all-horizon mixed-moment generating function and sharp negative covariance and correlation limits, not available from separately known marginals, a textbook reflection identity alone, or a prior endpoint covariance statement. The exact coefficient and limiting dependence can inform path-extreme and local-time joint analysis without promising further downstream theorems.
